note: Registry of x402 settlement facilitators. `addresses` are the on-chain submitters/fee-payers/co-signers used to CLASSIFY a USDC transfer as an x402 settlement. Grown empirically: any address that repeatedly submits transferWithAuthorization (EVM) or co-signs USDC atomic groups (Algorand) to many distinct payTo wallets is a candidate. Empty arrays are expected until bootstrapped from real chain data — see scripts/bootstrap-facilitators. Contract addresses (USDC) are NOT facilitators; see @agentkit/x402-core constants.
